notes.title: Update! Fix!
notes.content:
1. Added a new Health Potion crafting feature:
When using Free Cooking, you can craft a Health Potion using 20 Magic Liquids.

2. Updated the Health Potion description.

3. Fixed an issue where the audio and special effects would sometimes repeat when right-clicking to quickly upgrade a vehicle.

4. Optimized vehicle movement paths in some maps, adjusting some sudden jumps or twists.

5. Adjusted monster magic resistance values. When a monster's health bar shows armor with a certain magic element, the damage will be lower if you attack the monster without using the corresponding magic element's damage.

6. Fixed an issue where lighting sometimes rendered incorrectly in camps.

7. Fixed an issue where the Ice Dragon would sometimes not fire lasers.

notes.title: The demo version is now on STEAM!
notes.content:
The demo version is now on STEAM!
You are welcome to try it out for free!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2904420/_/

New Festival Demo Version Description:
1、Open the first chapter - forest level and the second chapter - desert level
2. Replace the monster model and combat action resources in Chapter One.
3. In the new battle, the body can choose different evolution direction when leveling up (the current version only opens the Arrow Tower and the Magic Vegetable Tower).
4. Adjusted the dishes and unlocked dishes for cooking at stalls (can unlock an additional “hamburger” recipe).
5、Support multi-language (Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese).

PS: Wishlist number is very important for indie games on steam! If you like our game, please add it for us. It's really, really important to us. Thank you all!
